headline: Bitstamp Flips To An 83.3 Million Dollar Outflow As Venue Outflow Climbs To 743.5 Million
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, climbed to a 743.5 million dollar net outflow, 0.2736 percent of custodied value, from a 256.5 million dollar outflow and 0.0953 percent on the prior print. Bitstamp flipped to an 83.3 million dollar outflow from a 239.3 million dollar intake, while Bitfinex sent out 311.4 million dollars and Binance sent out 243.6 million dollars, and Gemini took in 26.7 million dollars. A negative print means dollars left the venues where holders can sell, and a positive print means dollars arrived there.
author: jordan
